title: Ordinary etale chart formula forced by a scalar counit equation
statement: Let $A\to B$ be a unital map $\varphi$ of finite commutative rings, and let $N>0$ annihilate both. Let $X,Y,U$ be Noetherian schemes, $i:U\hookrightarrow X$ open, and $e:U\to\mathbf A^d_Y$ separated, quasi-compact, finite-type etale, with $if=ep_d$ for $f:X\to Y$. Fix a compactification $c$ of $f$, the two sum-extension normalizations, normalized finite Tate transports and projective-line adjunction data of [def-sp-reduction-exceptional-realization-objects], and assume $N$ invertible on $Y$. Let $F_R^{et}\dashv G_R^{et}$ be arbitrary ordinary compact-support adjunctions for $c$. Let $L\in D^b_{ctf}(Y,A)$, $L_B\in D(Y,B)$ and $a:T_YL\to L_B$. If $q:T_XG_A^{et}L\to G_B^{et}L_B$ satisfies $\beta(G_A^{et}L);F_B^{et}(q);\epsilon_B(L_B)=T_Y(\epsilon_A(L));a$ for the actual compactScalarMap, then $d_i^{-1};i_B^*(q);r_B(L_B)=T_U(r_A(L));t_{e,d}(L);(p_d^*(-)(d)[2d]\,e_B^*)(a)$. Here $r_R$ is exactly reductionEtaleChartRightIso and $t_{e,d}$ exactly reductionEtaleChartScalarIso. This states one ordinary-site component; there are no intrinsic realizations or chosen input-origin isomorphisms.

proof.text: Compose ordinary open sum/evaluation with the given compact-support adjunctions. The scalar/open counit equation identifies the restriction of q with the transpose of the scalar-extended composite counit followed by a.
Transport the left functors through reductionEtaleChartLeftIso. The normalized finite-ring chart adjunction is the sum/evaluation adjunction followed by ordered affine integration.

Use scalar compatibility of the actual sum-then-affine counit, the generator-normalized finite Tate-line comparison, and naturality at a. The resulting inverse transpose is that of the displayed canonical chart map.

Injectivity of the B-chart Hom equivalence gives the equality. Right-adjoint uniqueness identifies r_R with precisely the specified reductionEtaleChartRightIso. The identity affine adjunction handles d=0, and the generator identities include zero rings.

proof_origin.place: Named subargument of the retained Locality/Charts proof

theorem reductionExceptional_ordinary_chart
    {A B : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Finite A] [Finite B]
    (φ : A →+* B) (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (hA : (N : A) = 0) (hB : (N : B) = 0)
    {X Y U : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian Y] [IsNoetherian U]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (i : U ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion i]
    (d : ℕ) (e : U ⟶ affineTraceTower Y d)
    [AlgebraicGeometry.Etale e] [IsSeparated e] [LocallyOfFiniteType e] [QuasiCompact e]
    (he : i ≫ f = e ≫ affineTraceProjection Y d) (cf : Compactification f)
    (MA : Etale.EtaleCompactSupportNormalization A)
    (MB : Etale.EtaleCompactSupportNormalization B)
    (tA : Etale.OrdinaryFiniteTwistTransport A N hA)
    (DA : ∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian T] (hT : IsUnit (N : Γ(T, ⊤))),
      Etale.OrdinaryFiniteP1Datum A N hA tA T hT)
    (tB : Etale.OrdinaryFiniteTwistTransport B N hB)
    (DB : ∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian T] (hT : IsUnit (N : Γ(T, ⊤))),
      Etale.OrdinaryFiniteP1Datum B N hB tB T hT)
    (hY : IsUnit (N : Γ(Y, ⊤)))
    (GA : Etale.DerivedCategoryModule A Y ⥤ Etale.DerivedCategoryModule A X)
    (GB : Etale.DerivedCategoryModule B Y ⥤ Etale.DerivedCategoryModule B X)
    (adjA : Etale.rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactification
      (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) cf ⊣ GA)
    (adjB : Etale.rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactification
      (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) cf ⊣ GB)
    (L : Etale.DerivedCategoryModule A Y)
    (hL : Etale.DerivedCategory.boundedConstructibleFiniteTor A Y L)
    (LB : Etale.DerivedCategoryModule B Y)
    (a : (Etale.scalarExtension φ Y).obj L ⟶ LB)
    (q : (Etale.scalarExtension φ X).obj (GA.obj L) ⟶ GB.obj LB)
    (hq : (Etale.compactScalarMap φ cf).app (GA.obj L) ≫
        (Etale.rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactification (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) cf).map q ≫
        adjB.counit.app LB = (Etale.scalarExtension φ Y).map (adjA.counit.app L) ≫ a) :
    (Etale.scalarPullbackIso φ i).inv.app (GA.obj L) ≫
        (Etale.ordinaryFinitePullback B i).map q ≫
        (reductionEtaleChartRightIso B MB f i d e he cf GB adjB N hB tB DB hY).hom.app LB =
      (Etale.scalarExtension φ U).map
        ((reductionEtaleChartRightIso A MA f i d e he cf GA adjA N hA tA DA hY).hom.app L) ≫
      (reductionEtaleChartScalarIso φ N hA hB hY d e L).hom ≫
      (Etale.affineTraceRight B N hB Y d ⋙ Etale.ordinaryFinitePullback B e).map a
